subject: Encord / [COMPANY] - best-in-class ML models
text:
Hi [NAME],

I recently read that [COMPANY] has addressed over 200,000 safety scenarios -
an impressive stat that speaks to the scale and complexity of your ML
systems. We recently caught up with the AI team at Nuro at CVPR, who were
struggling with visualizing and curating 100s of hours of driving data, so
I thought it might be worth reaching out to see if you're facing similar
challenges at [COMPANY]?

We work w/ many autonomous vehicle/robotic AI teams (Woven by Toyota, Fox
Robotics etc) and enable them to curate data across hundreds of millions of
multimodal files (image, video, LiDAR, PCD, audio), using metadata
filtering, similarity search, embedding visualization, etc. This allows
them to better surface edge cases to improve perception, prediction, and
planning models.

For context… Encord is a end-to-end ML data ops platform for data
visualization, curation and annotation allowing team to label data 2x-10x
faster than in-house or first gen tools, resulting in shorter model
iteration cycles & improved model performance.

Would you be open to a quick intro call this week or next - I'm free this
Thursday/Friday mornings? Happy to flex as needed.

mornings.

subject: Encord Intro - Working w/ Lime on end-of-ride ML models
text:

and boosts model performance.

subject: Encord & [COMPANY] - Spoke w/ Max Gariel about synthetic vs real-world data
text:
Hi [NAME],

I had a great chat with Max Gariel who came to a recent Encord AI mixer in
SF - he mentioned your work on perception at Joby and flagged some of the
work you're doing to balance synthetic vs real-world data (especially
across altitudes, weather, and viewpoints around the airport).

We've been working w/ similar autonomy teams (e.g. Skydio, Woven by Toyota,
Zipline) who had similar challenges - trying to stress-test models across
operational domains to confidently say where it will work and where it
won't. Max mentioned this was particularly difficult when rotating the
viewpoint or varying environmental conditions e.g. rain/sunny conditions.

For context, Encord is a ML DataOps scale-up (Series B, raised £50m) that
unifies data curation, annotation and model eval under one platform (+
labelling services).

When works for a quick chat? We're free next Wednesday between 11am-2pm
(PT) to share how others are tackling similar challenges.
